findings.claim: The wallpaper boot scene is NOT THRF9FD: camdat.json models[0] = APU0002.glb (hospital); the no-scene boot probes models[0].file first (v33.8 discovery order).

findings.evidence: frame-by-frame first 8 ticks all big < 0.0009; t=0..5 all big < 0.001

findings.claim: A latent divergence channel exists (the camdat env weatherTarget=2 -> 512-tick sine cross-fade at boot, 17s ramp) but is NOT triggered in the default boot (envBootWeather=-1, no --weather-target; measured identical renders with env stripped vs present: mean 0.00).

verdict: NOT a lively-port regression. The lively engine is bit-faithful to PoC v33.25-base on every measured path (md5-identical renders on identical argv). The 'pop-in' the user sees is engine-faithful PoC behavior (cam-track sweep pulse on the default APU0002 boot scene, or weather ramp if their copy selects it). No engine change proposed: changing it would break verbatim parity. The companion PoC-engine merge (v33.26) may change this behavior via the v43 fixes — recommend the user re-test after the merge PR lands.
